game_over.author: Kenney
game_over.notes: Kenney CC0 source retained unchanged. FFmpeg 8.1.2 +genpts audio stream-copy remux repairs missing presentation timestamps for Chromium; bitexact output ensures reproducible Ogg serials. All 30 compressed packet hashes unchanged, no transcode. Original 8064 decoded samples identical; repaired timestamps expose an additional 128-sample decoder tail (8192 total).
